conversa.ajudouRegra: Only who opened the conversation (and the moderators) marks the reply that helped. There is only one per conversation.
conversa.fediverso: Reply from the Fediverse, from the server {servidor}

conversa.travada: The moderators locked this conversation: no new replies.

reacoes.regra: We show only the total for each emoji, never who reacted, not even to the author. Below 3, we say “a few”.

ativas.regra: The ones with the most posts in the last 7 days. No algorithm, no sponsorship.
